resources.string: Connect one or more panels you own. No central panel or bot token is required.
Hub metadata and its subscription-link copy are encrypted with Android Keystore. Links are hidden here; the existing subscription engine also keeps an app-private record.

Remove this panel and its imported configurations?
This removes the local subscription and its profiles. It does not delete anything on your panel.
Panel connected. Sync it to import configurations.
Pairing works only when your panel exposes /api/app/pair. A 404 is reported honestly; you can always use a subscription link.

Run real subscription sync and panel health checks. Each panel reports its own result; a failed panel is never counted as synchronized.
No user-owned panels are connected. Add one in Omni Panel first.

Select at least one panel first.
Finished with one or more failed panel operations. Open each row for evidence.
Test every configuration in the selected subscription through the real native core. Core ping, tunnel TTFB and byte-counted download/upload throughput remain separate.
Each size is bounded to 1 KiB–16 MiB. Upload is sent only when an upload URL is supplied; measured data includes any fallback attempt.
TTFB is header latency through the tunnel. Throughput uses bytes and elapsed time; neither is inferred from edge ping.
Subscriptions and saved profiles could not be loaded.
Choose a subscription with saved configurations first.
Check HTTP(S) URLs and sizes from 1024 to 16777216 bytes.

Enter a host, a port from 1 to 65535 and a network.
Compare real system-resolver and DNS-over-HTTPS answers. Every provider keeps its own status, latency and answers.
The queried name is sent to every selected DoH provider. System answers may come from the OS resolver/cache; no tunnel-only claim is made.
Enter a valid DNS name and an HTTPS custom DoH endpoint when selected.
All selected resolvers returned a DNS response.
One or more resolver queries failed; successful rows remain independent.
Inspect pairing capabilities and erase access deliberately. Tokens and subscription URLs are never rendered here.

Profiles use the existing app stores. Panel metadata, subscription links and scoped bearer sessions are encrypted with an Android Keystore-backed store; administrator, bot and Cloudflare tokens are not accepted.
Backup and notification controls remain in their existing real screens. Review any exported backup before sharing it.
Revoke all active pairings on panels
Each active panel is contacted separately. A failed request stays paired locally and is counted as failed; no offline success is claimed.
This erases local scoped sessions, including expired ones. It does not contact panels and does not revoke server-side access.
No connected panels or scoped sessions are present.
No active scoped pairing reported locally; an expired token may still need local Forget.
Privacy storage could not be read; no erasure is claimed.
There is no active scoped pairing for this action.
Requested active pairings were revoked on their panels and removed locally.
Some revokes failed. Successful panels were removed locally; failed panels remain paired.
Local pairing-token cleanup completed. Server-side access was not changed by this action.
